subject: Sales systems contract renewal orchestration (Outreach) - action items
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@outreach.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@outreach.io>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Outreach renewal: quote and options for Redwood Inference

Hi Vanessa / Team,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Attached is the renewal quote for your Outreach subscription (Outreach Core + Advanced Sequences add-on). I included two options: a 12-month committed term with a 10% early-renew discount, and a month-to-month extension with pricing hold for 60 days.

Key line items are called out on page 2 but here’s the short version:
- Seats: 115 licensed users
- Avg monthly spend (committed): $24,800/mo
- Onboarding/enablement credit applied: $15k one-time credit

If you want, I can prepare an amendment and send for e-signature; otherwise I can loop in our contracts team to run standard T&Cs. Any specific procurement requirements I should know about?

Attachments: Outreach_Renewal_Quote_Q2-2027.pdf

Best,
Oliver
Account Executive, Outreach
oliver@outreach.io
+1 (415) 555-0189
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@outreach.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: quote and options for Redwood Inference

Oliver — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying asks before we move to amendments: 

1) Can you send a per-seat effective cost table (by license tier) and called-out overage rules? We want to map to our internal chargeback model.
2) Do you have a standard data handling addendum we can attach? We may need SOC2 evidence; our security team will request it.
3) Is the 10% applied to list or net? Please show a worked example.

Ben / Marissa / Laura — please review the attached quote when you have a minute. Laura — finance will need a payment schedule (net-30 vs net-45) and any refund terms.

Happy to carve out 30 minutes tomorrow to sync if helpful.

—Vanessa
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: quote and options for Redwood Inference

Quick internal note — I skimmed the numbers and two thoughts: 
- We should validate if Outreach will allow trimming 15 seats at scale-down checkpoints (quarterly). That flexibility matters for SDR churn.
- Also want to baseline a product switch cost: Salesloft is quoting aggressively to our procurement (I asked procurement to get a rough TCO). If Outreach won’t move on annual seat pricing, we may need a competitive lever.

I can join the call tomorrow and bring a short TCO slide if helpful.

Ben
Head of Sales Ops
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@outreach.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@outreach.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: quote and options for Redwood Inference

Vanessa / team,

Thanks for the detailed questions — answers inline and attached: Outreach_Amendment_v2.pdf (includes per-seat breakout and the DPA reference).

1) Per-seat table: included on p3 (Core $99/user/mo, Advanced Sequences $40/user/mo). The 10% is off the net recurring for the committed term (example calculation on p4 shows final $22,320/mo for 115 seats).
2) DPA & SOC2: see appendix B of the amendment (SOC2 Type II report can be shared under NDA — I included the link for your security lead).
3) Flexibility: we can include a quarterly reduction clause up to 10% headcount without penalty; larger reductions require 30 days notice and pro-rated credits.

If the terms look good I can send the amendment to contracts@redwood.ai via DocuSign. If you want to negotiate further on the committed seat rate, we have limited headroom but can discuss a stepped discount for >130 seats.

Attachments: Outreach_Amendment_v2.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/placeholder-sign-123

Regards,
Oliver
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@outreach.io>, Contracts Team <contracts@outreach.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outreach renewal: quote and options for Redwood Inference

Oliver — appreciate the thoroughness and the SOC2 pointer. Internal decision: we’ll proceed with the 12-month committed path and the amendment, subject to standard redline checks from our legal. Next steps: 

- Oliver & Outreach Contracts: please send the amendment to contracts@redwood.ai and include a clear payment schedule (we prefer net-30).
- Laura (Finance): can you confirm that PO path and whether we can do ACH vs card?
- Ben / Marissa: I’ll schedule a 30-min kick-off to align enablement timeline and seat provisioning (aiming for renewal effective 2027-05-01).

Thanks — moment to note: if Salesloft comes back with a materially better committed rate before we sign, we may pause final sign-off for 48 hours to evaluate. Otherwise execute.

—Vanessa
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
